name: Meren of Clan Nel Toth
oracle_text:
Whenever another creature you control dies, you get an experience counter.
At the beginning of your end step, choose target creature card in your graveyard. If that card's mana value is less than or equal to the number of experience counters you have, return it to the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand.
blocked_sentences: Whenever another creature you control dies, you get an experience counter.

At the beginning of your end step, choose target creature card in your graveyard. If that card's mana value is less than or equal to the number of experience counters you have, return it to the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand.

needs.what: an experience counter kind on players (122.1): a PlayerState field listed in PLAYER_COUNTER_KINDS so proliferate and lose_all_player_counters see it, an op that gives a player N experience counters (like add_poison/add_energy), and a value that reads how many experience counters a player has, for comparison against mana_value_of a target
needs.why_existing_wont_do: PLAYER_COUNTER_KINDS carries only poison and energy; add_poison and add_energy are fixed to those kinds, add_counters puts counters on objects not players, and counters_on reads object counters, so neither giving nor reading an experience counter can be said. Substituting energy would let other energy cards spend Meren's experience, a different card
